deviations.what: runner invoked with a relative probe path while cwd = record dir; child exited 2 before any computation; retained; rerun as p1-p21-structure-v1-a2 with absolute path

the probe's own 270 s self-budget was checked only between H values, not inside the DFS of the first H; the first H alone exceeded the budget; the frozen runner (run_probe_v1.py 6f674add…) sent its designed owned SIGTERM to the child's own process group at 300.6 s wall; child returned -15; no output; receipt status FAILED_OR_STOPPED, settled=true; no SIGKILL; no other process touched
deviations.impact: no scientific result; only the qualitative lower bound 'static-order Python DFS needs > 300 s for the first canonical H' is used, labelled as such
deviations.fix: future probes check the budget inside inner loops
